Local._comment: Port: the one listener (127.0.0.1 only; `./orkka start --port` overrides it). DataDir: the database (orkka.db), blobs + sessions (default %ORKKA_HOME%/data or ~/.orkka/data). UiDir: the built web UI (default <repo>/ui/apps/local/dist). Secrets never come from this file or the environment: `./orkka start` hands them over in memory.
